sprint_note: Sprint 08: copy_entry backend accepts optional body with logged_at; EntriesPage adds date context + passes to copy; EntryDetailPage adds date picker split + fixed Save; ShellEntry FoodIntake adds date context + fixed Accept.

files.role: Entry CRUD router — copy_entry now accepts optional JSON body with logged_at to support caller-specified date

methods.name: copy_entry
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Accept optional JSON body. If body contains logged_at (valid ISO-8601 datetime string), use it for the copy's logged_at. Otherwise fall back to datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S'). All other fields: source row values as before.

files.role: Entries overview — add date context picker; pass selected date to copy handler

methods.name: EntriesPage
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Add selectedDate state (YYYY-MM-DD, default = today via new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA')). Render date input in page header. Pass selectedDate into handleCopy. handleCopy POSTs JSON body { logged_at: selectedDate + 'T12:00:00' } to /api/food/entries/:id/copy.

files.role: Entry detail/edit — add date+time split picker for logged_at; add fixed Save button at top-right

methods.name: EntryDetailPage
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Replace logged_at text input with date input (type='date') + time input (type='time') pair. Add fixed Save button (position:fixed, top:1rem, right:1rem, zIndex:100). Keep existing inline save feedback.

files.role: FoodIntake component — add date context picker; pre-populate template timestamp; fix Accept button in preview state

methods.name: FoodIntake
methods.purpose: [CHANGED] Add selectedDate state (YYYY-MM-DD, default today). Render date input above paste area. When template is displayed, replace template timestamp date portion with selectedDate. In preview state, render Accept button as fixed top-right; Back remains inline.
